hooks.prompt: You are gating a Bash command before it runs. The command is in this hook input JSON: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST decide whether the command is a `git push`. If it is NOT a git push (e.g. curl, npm, supabase, git status/add/commit, node, ls, etc.), respond to ALLOW it immediately with no reminder. ONLY if the command IS a `git push` (to production — there is no staging branch): remind the user that `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` should both pass first, and ALLOW the push if both have already passed in this session; otherwise ask them to run those first. When in doubt, ALLOW.
